pairs: Rursumque filii Israël fecerunt malum in conspectu Domini:
And again, the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord.
qui tradidit eos in manus Philisthinorum quadraginta annis.
And he delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.
Erat autem quidam vir de Saraa,
Now there was a certain man from Zorah,
and of the stock of Dan,
Cui apparuit angelus Domini, et dixit ad eam:
And an Angel of the Lord appeared to her, and he said:
But you shall conceive and bear a son.
take care that you do not drink wine or strong drink.
Neither shall you eat anything unclean.
For you shall conceive and bear a son,
whose head no razor shall touch.
For he shall be a Nazirite of God,
erit enim nazaræus Dei ab infantia sua et ex matris utero,
from his infancy and from his mother’s womb.
et ipse incipiet liberare Israël de manu Philisthinorum.
And he shall begin to free Israel from the hand of the Philistines.”
Quæ cum venisset ad maritum suum, dixit ei:
And when she had gone to her husband, she said to him:
“A man of God came to me,
having the countenance of an Angel,
And when I had inquired of him, who he was,
and what name he was called,
he was not willing to tell me.
you shall conceive and bear a son.
Take care that you do not drink wine or strong drink.
And you shall not consume anything unclean.
For the boy shall be a Nazirite of God from his infancy,
erit enim puer nazaræus Dei ab infantia sua,
ex utero matris suæ usque ad diem mortis suæ.
even until the day of his death.’”
And so Manoah prayed to the Lord, and he said,
et doceat nos quid debeamus facere de puero, qui nasciturus est.
and may teach us what we ought to do about the boy who is to be born.”
And the Lord heeded the prayer of Manoah,
et apparuit rursum angelus Dei uxori ejus sedenti in agro:
and the Angel of the Lord appeared again to his wife, sitting in a field.
Manue autem maritus ejus non erat cum ea.
But her husband Manoah was not with her.
And when she had seen the Angel,
she hurried and ran to her husband.
Tu es qui locutus es mulieri?
“Are you the one who spoke to my wife?”
What do you want the boy to do?
aut a quo se observare debebit?
Or from what should he keep himself?”
And the Angel of the Lord said to Manoah:
Ab omnibus, quæ locutus sum uxori tuæ,
“Concerning all the things about which I have spoken to your wife,
And let her eat nothing from the vine.
and keep what I have instructed to her.”
And Manoah said to the Angel of the Lord,
Obsecro te ut acquiescas precibus meis,
“I beg you to agree to my petition,
et faciamus tibi hædum de capris.
and to let us prepare a kid from the goats.”
I will not eat from your bread.
But if you are willing to offer a holocaust,
Et nesciebat Manue quod angelus Domini esset.
And Manoah did not know that he was an Angel of the Lord.
Tulit itaque Manue hædum de capris,
Manoah took a kid from the goats,
and he placed them upon a rock,
as an offering to the Lord,
Then he and his wife watched.
Cumque ascenderet flamma altaris in cælum,
And when the flame of the altar ascended to heaven,
angelus Domini pariter in flamma ascendit.
the Angel of the Lord ascended in the flame.
Quod cum vidissent Manue et uxor ejus,
And when Manoah and his wife had seen this,
they fell prone on the ground.
et ultra eis non apparuit angelus Domini.
And the Angel of the Lord no longer appeared to them.
Statimque intellexit Manue angelum Domini esse,
And immediately, Manoah understood him to be an Angel of the Lord.
And he said to his wife,
“If the Lord wished to kill us,
de manibus nostris holocaustum et libamenta non suscepisset,
he would not have accepted the holocaust and the libations from our hands.
He would not have revealed all these things to us,
neque ea quæ sunt ventura dixisset.
nor would he have told us the things that are in the future.”
And so she bore a son,
and she called his name Samson.
Cœpitque spiritus Domini esse cum eo in castris Dan inter Saraa
And the Spirit of the Lord began to be with him in the camp of Dan,
